ErtObservationsSeismicResultRow.description:
Represents the columns of a row in a Ert seismic observation export.

These fields are the current agreed upon standard result. Changes to the fields or
their validation should cause the version defined in the standard result schema to
increase the version number in a way that corresponds to the schema versioning
specification (i.e. they are a patch, minor, or major change).

east.description: The east coordinate this row represents. Required.
east.title: East

north.description: The north coordinate this row represents. Required.
north.title: North

observation_error.description: The observation error in std this row represents. Required.
observation_error.title: Observation Error

observation_value.description: The observation value this row represents. Required.
observation_value.title: Observation Value

response_key.description: The response key this row represents. Required.
response_key.title: Response Key

ErtObservationsSeismicResultRow.title: ErtObservationsSeismicResultRow

description:
Represents the resultant Ert seismic observations parquet file, which is
naturally a list of rows.

Consumers who retrieve this parquet file must read it into a json-dictionary
equivalent format to validate it against the schema.
title: ErtObservationsSeismicResult
